keyingIntroduction: Send Morse yourself and measure your timing and spacing.
keyingKeyboardHelp: Click this key, then hold and release Space. You can also use a mouse or touch. Space works normally in text fields.
keyingSoundUnavailable: The key tone is unavailable. Visual keying and timing still work.
keyingMeasurementNote: Decoding uses your target speed; incorrect timing may produce a different letter. Effective speed is the PARIS equivalent of marks and gaps between the first press and last release. Waiting after the attempt is excluded. Each new attempt replaces the previous result.
keyingInterrupted: An unfinished press was discarded. Losing focus or holding for over 10 seconds releases the key.
keyingIgnoredTaps: Inputs shorter than 5 ms were ignored.
keyingLimit: This attempt reached the 4096-mark limit. Start a new attempt.
keyingDotShort: Dots are shorter than the target; hold slightly longer.
keyingDotLong: Dots are longer than the target; release sooner.
keyingDashShort: Dashes are too short; a dash should last three dots.
keyingDashLong: Dashes are too long; a dash should last three dots.
keyingElementGapShort: Elements within a letter are too close; wait one dot.
keyingElementGapLong: Elements within a letter are too far apart; wait one dot.
keyingLetterGapShort: Letters are too close; leave a three-dot gap.
keyingLetterGapLong: Letter gaps are too long; leave a three-dot gap.
keyingWordGapShort: Words are too close; leave a seven-dot gap.
keyingWordGapLong: Word gaps are too long; leave a seven-dot gap.
keyingBalanced: Dots, dashes and gaps match the target rhythm.
keyingUneven: Average durations are close, but individual presses vary. Keep an even rhythm.
keyingUnrecognized: This mark sequence is not recognized in the selected alphabet (�). Check the elements and letter gaps.
